descriptions.has_property: Thing has a property or attribute
descriptions.agent_of: Node is the agent performing an action
descriptions.patient_of: Node is the patient receiving an action
descriptions.instrument_of: Node is the instrument used in an action
descriptions.time_of: Node is the time at which action occurs
descriptions.place_of: Node is the place where action occurs
descriptions.caused_by: Source node is caused by target node
descriptions.supports: Source supports or provides evidence for target
descriptions.requires_evidence: Source requires evidence to be accepted
descriptions.has_certainty_policy: Node has a specific certainty policy
descriptions.sourced_from: Claim is sourced from a source node
descriptions.not_equivalent_to: Explicitly marks two nodes as NOT equivalent
